import re
WARN = re.compile(r'^(?P<file>\S.*?):(?P<line>\d+): (?P<category>\w+): (?P<message>\S.*?)\s*$')
NOTE = re.compile(r'^\w+(?:Warning|Error): \S')
SRC = re.compile(r'^\s+(?P<source>\S.*?)\s*$')

def parse(lines):
    recs, used = [], []
    for i, ln in enumerate(lines):
        if not ln.strip():
            continue
        m = WARN.match(ln)
        if m:
            recs.append({'file': m.group('file'), 'line': m.group('line'),
                         'category': m.group('category'), 'message': m.group('message'),
                         'source': '', 'note': ''})
            used.append(i)
            continue
        if not recs:
            continue
        rec = recs[-1]
        m = SRC.match(ln)
        if m:
            rec['source'] = (rec['source'] + ' ' + m.group('source')).strip()
            used.append(i)
        elif NOTE.match(ln):
            rec['note'] = (rec['note'] + '; ' + ln.strip()).strip('; ')
            used.append(i)
    return [{'name': 'warnings', 'kind': 'table', 'lines': used, 'records': recs}]
